subject: SignalFlow discovery — tech next steps & prompt governance kickoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Omar Rahman <omar@signalflow.ai>, Priya Sen <priya.sen@signalflow.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SignalFlow discovery — tech next steps & prompt governance kickoff

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation, really appreciated the walk-through of your ingestion pipeline and the ranking problems you want to solve. Recap + proposed next steps below so we can sync engineering teams: 

Short recap
- Goal: real-time semantic search + reranking over agent chat transcripts (<= 2s latency target for search+rerank single-shot)
- Primary constraints: PII redaction, EU-resident data subset, and desire for per-tenant prompt customization

Proposed technical kickoff items (owners + rough ETA)
1) SDK & auth proof-of-concept (Dev) — get a local dev flow with Redwood SDK using service account keys + optional OAuth (ETA 4 business days)
2) Routing + fallbacks (Karthik) — define routing policy: low-latency region routing, fallback to smaller quantized model under load (ETA 1 week)
3) Structured output & tool calling (Marissa) — example schema for agent actions + safety predicates (ETA 5 business days)
4) Embeddings/reranker evaluation (SignalFlow + Dev) — sample dataset + baseline metrics to compare dense vs hybrid reranker (ETA 10 business days)
5) Prompt/version governance kickoff (Karthik + Marissa) — initial policy doc covering prompt versioning, injection mitigations, red-team cadence (initial draft in 1 week)

Attachments: high-level infra sketch and a kickoff checklist attached.

Action items for SignalFlow team
- Share a 200–500 message sample (anonymized) we can use for embeddings eval (Priya)
- Confirm compliance constraints for EU subset (Omar)

Can we schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff on Thurs (June 24) at 10:00 PT? If that works, we’ll invite the infra folks and drop a proposed agenda.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Omar Rahman <omar@signalflow.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sen <priya.sen@signalflow.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalFlow discovery — tech next steps & prompt governance kickoff

Thanks Karthik — this is super helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can provide a 500-message anonymized sample by end of day Wednesday. It contains user transcripts + agent responses.
- EU subset: we host tenant data in GCP europe-west1; we need a VPC/private deployment for that subset (SOC-2 already, but have tighter residency needs).
- Latency target: 2s end-to-end for search+rerank is ideal; we can accept 2.5s during POC.

Two additional asks:
1) Can you outline the minimum auth pattern you recommend for the POC? We currently have API keys + internal OAuth; prefer short-lived tokens if possible.
2) For prompt governance: we need an in-band way to pin a tenant-specific system prompt and a mechanism to audit prompt changes over time.

Thurs 10am PT works for the kickoff — go ahead and send calendar invite.

Best,
Omar
VP Product, SignalFlow AI

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Omar Rahman <omar@signalflow.ai>, Priya Sen <priya.sen@signalflow.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalFlow discovery — tech next steps & prompt governance kickoff

Great — quick answers inline, and I’ve attached a short "Redwood POC auth patterns" note for reference.

Auth pattern recommendation (minimum for POC)
- Service account with short-lived JWTs minted by your auth service (recommended) or
- OAuth2 authorization code flow if users need interactive login; for machine-to-machine, prefer signed JWT + exchange for short-lived token at Redwood’s token endpoint
- TLS + mTLS (optional) between your routing gateway and Redwood private endpoint if you choose VPC mode

Prompt pinning & audit ideas
- Provide an external prompt config record per tenant (versioned) — Redwood will accept a prompt_id header on the request and record prompt_id + prompt_hash in audit logs
- UI/CLI: an admin can create new prompt versions (v1, v2), add a short changelog and require approval before activation
- For injection mitigation: we’ll run a lightweight static sanitizer on inputs + an explicit context-length bounded instruction window; we also recommend a post-generation classifier for hallucination/safety checks

Meeting: invite sent for Thu, Jun 24 10:00 PT (30 min). Agenda attached in the invite.

Next steps for Redwood team:
- Dev to spin up SDK quickstart that shows token mint -> call -> sample rerank flow (Dev)
- Marissa to draft a structured-output schema and a sample tool call contract for agent actions (Marissa)

Karthik

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Omar Rahman <omar@signalflow.ai>, Priya Sen <priya.sen@signalflow.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalFlow discovery — tech next steps & prompt governance kickoff

Omar/Priya — I started a small SDK quickstart (node + python) that demonstrates:
- service-account JWT exchange -> short-lived token
- embedding creation and a simple cosine-search sample
- a reranking endpoint call that accepts a structured candidate list and returns a sorted set with scores and debug traces (we include model_id, quantization profile, token_cost estimate)

Notes / decisions we think matter for POC:
- Routing: we’ll add a header X-Redwood-Routing: region=us-west1, fallback=quantized-8bit. This lets your gateway steer traffic by tenant/region.
- Structured output: use explicit JSON schema + a top-level "safety" object that enumerates triggers (blocked_phrases, redaction_mask). Example tool-call contract included in attachment.
- Embeddings: start with ada-like dense vectors (128d) + Faiss index for POC; if recall is low we’ll propose a hybrid BM25+dense reranker.

Attachment: quickstart code links (in invite) and a small diagram (signalflow_infra_sketch.pdf).

Quick ask: can you confirm whether your anonymization pipeline strips PII fields or if we should run a secondary redaction step on our side? If SignalFlow wants to keep a copy of original transcripts, we recommend they stay in your GCP project and we only receive an anonymized export.

- Dev

From: Priya Sen <priya.sen@signalflow.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Omar Rahman <omar@signalflow.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalFlow discovery — tech next steps & prompt governance kickoff

Thanks everyone — the POC plan looks solid. Quick replies:
- We’ll deliver the anonymized 500-message sample by EOD Wednesday (shared Drive link in the invite). We currently strip names and phone numbers but keep entity tags for evaluation; if you need extra redaction we’ll coordinate during kickoff.
- EU subset: confirmed; we want the EU tenants routed to a private VPC deployment (we’ll accept a separate dedicated instance for that cohort).
- Prompt pinning / audit: the prompt_id header approach works for us. Also keen on the changelog + approval workflow — can you include an initial PR template for prompt changes in the prompt-versioning-proposal.md attachment?

Looking forward to the kickoff tomorrow.

—Priya
Head of ML Engineering, SignalFlow AI
